lines.text: Welcome back, story maker! Today your characters will have real conversations.
A character can say many things.
Put the say blocks in the order you want them.
Put moves between the say blocks.
The character walks, then talks, then walks again.
In ScratchJr, two characters can take turns.
One talks, the other waits, then answers.
The orange wait block makes a character pause, so the other one can talk.
The dog says “Hi!”, walks to the ball (star), then says “Let’s play!”.
Hi — walk — let’s play! Perfect order.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
